task.description: Canonicalize mcp_client.py: ensure __enter__/__exit__, fix stale-attribute bug in __exit__, make package optional for AC4 lifecycle smoke test
task.changes: (a) __init__: changed signature from `package: str` to `package: Optional[str] = None` so the AC4 spec test `MCPClient()` constructs without args.
